mapper.sql: select h.history_id, h.user_id, h.target_type, h.target_id, h.video_id, h.position, h.duration, h.last_view_time, h.create_time, case h.target_type when 'shortVideo' then (select v.video_title from learning_short_video v where v.video_id = h.target_id) when 'course' then (select c.course_name from learning_course c where c.course_id = h.target_id) when 'post' then (select p.post_title from learning_post p where p.post_id = h.target_id) end as title, case h.target_type when 'shortVideo' then (select v.cover_url from learning_short_video v where v.video_id = h.target_id) when 'course' then (select c.cover_url from learning_course c where c.course_id = h.target_id) end as cover_url, case h.target_type when 'course' then (select v.video_title from learning_course_video v where v.video_id = h.video_id) end as subtitle, case h.target_type when 'shortVideo' then (select v.del_flag from learning_short_video v where v.video_id = h.target_id) when 'course' then (select c.del_flag from learning_course c where c.course_id = h.target_id) when 'post' then (select p.del_flag from learning_post p where p.post_id = h.target_id) end as source_del_flag from learning_watch_history h
mapper.select: select h.history_id, h.user_id, h.target_type, h.target_id, h.video_id, h.position, h.duration, h.last_view_time, h.create_time from learning_watch_history h where h.user_id = #{userId} and h.target_type = #{targetType} and h.target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.insert: insert into learning_watch_history (user_id, target_type, target_id, video_id, position, duration, last_view_time, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{videoId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{position,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{duration,jdbcType=INTEGER}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update learning_watch_history set video_id = #{videoId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, position = #{position,jdbcType=INTEGER}, duration = #{duration,jdbcType=INTEGER}, last_view_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.delete: delete from learning_watch_history where history_id = #{historyId} and user_id = #{userId}
delete from learning_watch_history where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType}
mapper.select: select count(*) from learning_short_video where video_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from learning_course where course_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from learning_post where post_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from learning_course_video where video_id = #{videoId} and course_id = #{courseId} and del_flag = '0'
select duration from learning_short_video where video_id = #{targetId}
mapper.update: update learning_short_video set view_count = view_count + 1 where video_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0'
update learning_course set view_count = view_count + 1 where course_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0'
update learning_post set view_count = view_count + 1 where post_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0'
